evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 紫碧山房
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鴻慈永祜後垣西北為紫碧山房前宇為横雲堂山房東巖洞中為石帆室東南為豐樂軒北為霽華樓迤東為景暉樓横雲堂西池上為澄素樓西北為引溪亭（圎圓明園册）臣等謹按紫碧山房額有二其一恭懸正宇内一懸穿堂門檐與引溪亭額皆世宗御書紫碧山房正宇檐額曰樂在人和及横雲堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: North-west beyond the rear wall of 鴻慈永祜: 紫碧山房 with 横雲堂, the cave room 石帆室, 豐樂軒, 霽華樓, 景暉樓, 澄素樓 on the pond and 引溪亭.

evidence.title: 丰乐轩 in 紫碧山房
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鴻慈永祜後垣西北為紫碧山房前宇為横雲堂山房東巖洞中為石帆室東南為豐樂軒北為霽華樓
evidence.summary: S05 puts 丰乐轩 south-east of 石帆室 in 紫碧山房.: S01 labels it in YM22.

evidence.title: 丰乐轩: 乾隆二十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十六年 (1761), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 文轩额取郭槖传，学圃因之亦课田。欲阜吾民无别术，䖍恭一意为祈年。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 丰乐轩, 1761, on the harvest. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 丰乐轩
evidence.locator: v3 p.126, under 紫碧山房; source ref 9-293
evidence.excerpt_zh: 北村缀景有田园，学圃兼将学稼论。望矣因之号丰乐，诚然实不易由言。
evidence.summary: Poem 丰乐轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1767, filed by the editors under 紫碧山房.

evidence.title: 丰乐轩: 乾隆四十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆四十二年 (1777), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 昨秋各省丰者多，近始京畿达远省。况是弄田灌溉勤，自宜仓箱堆积整。十岁中鲜四五遇，丰则丰矣乐艰骋。缱彼胼手胝足民，虽亦逢稔称厚幸。官租私债仍当还，几曾温饱亲受领。敬体前题识农艰，（轩额乃皇考御书也）惟有祈年志䖍永。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 丰乐轩, 1777, on the harvest. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 丰乐轩: 乾隆五十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十年 (1785), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 御园隙地多弄田，轩名丰乐祈农寓。去岁北省率有秋，弄田益庆仓箱裕。然而斯庆岂易得，十岁难逢五六遇。人益滋而谷益贵，歉必增价丰如故。（承平生齿日繁，谷价日贵，而百物亦因之日昻。间遇歉岁必至増价，及丰收而价仍不减，实事势相因难以就平也。）谷贵诸物胥价贵，往往十年倍其数。持盈保泰实艰㢤，长此安穷吾益惧。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 丰乐轩, 1785, on the harvest. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 题丰乐轩
evidence.locator: v3 p.120, under 紫碧山房; source ref 8-386
evidence.excerpt_zh: 文轩额取郭橐传，学圃因之亦课田。欲阜吾民无别术，虔恭一意为祈年。
evidence.summary: Poem 题丰乐轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 紫碧山房.

evidence.title: 圆明园景点建筑命名对古代文学遗产的继承与发展
evidence.summary: How scene and hall names come from literature: 上下天光 from 范仲淹, 杏花春馆 from 杜牧, 武陵春色 from 陶渊明, 坐石临流 from 兰亭, and 丰乐轩 and 顺木天 from 柳宗元. It also quotes the 陶渊明 line 平畴交远风. It places 丰乐轩, three bays facing north, in the 紫碧山房 scene.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 丰乐轩
evidence.locator: from p.200, under 紫碧山房
evidence.summary: The compiler describes a three-bay hall with galleries all round facing north, with Yongzheng's plaque and a gallery running north-east to the farm plot 学圃. 丰乐轩: 16 dated items, 1761-1814, of which 16 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the harvest, the view. First dated 1761, last dated 1814.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 紫碧山房
evidence.summary: Enlarged about 1760: inner gate, 含余清, the octagonal 翼翠亭, 丰乐轩, 纳翠轩, the boat-shaped 石帆室, the three-storey 景晖楼, 横云堂, a five-bay main hall 乐在人和, 澄素楼, 霁华楼. After 1860 the inner gate, main hall and 顺木天 pavilion survived under guard and were lost around 1900, say the editors.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
